cues: The electrical wave can be recorded from the skin: the E C G.
The P wave is the atria depolarising.
The Q R S complex is the ventricles depolarising, just before they contract.
The T wave is the ventricles repolarising.
Heart rate is sixty divided by the R to R interval in seconds.
